Attendance Ingestion Trigger
(Date D, Employee E)

span.p:
Query dated_shift_instance
(WHERE tenant_id=:t AND employee_id=:e AND shift_date=:d)

span.p:
Is Instance Marked
is_adhoc_modified = true
(Supervisor Override)?

span.p:
Is Employee Assigned
to a ShiftPool
(shift_pool_id IS NOT NULL)?

span.p:
Fetch First Clock-In Punch (P_in)
for Date D Window

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Await Ingestion or Shift Cutoff
(Status = NO_PUNCH)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Load Candidate Shifts in Pool:
Pool = {S_1, S_2, ..., S_m}

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Filter Shifts Where:
T_start,i - W_pre <= P_in <= T_start,i + W_window

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Flag Anomaly: UNRESOLVED_SHIFT_ANOMALY
Enqueue to HR Exception Queue

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Calculate Arrival Delta for each Candidate:
Delta_i = |P_in - T_start,i|

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Await Clock-Out Punch (P_out)
Evaluate Maximum Shift Overlap Ratio

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Materialize dated_shift_instance:
- shift_template_id = S*.id
- resolution_mode = AUTO_DYNAMIC_MATCH
- sessions = S*.session_definitions

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Validate Supervisor RBAC Permissions
& Organization Hierarchy

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Update dated_shift_instance:
- set shift_template_id = new_template_id
- set sessions = new_sessions
- set is_adhoc_modified = true
- set modified_by_user_id = supervisor_id

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Write Append-Only audit_logs Record:
- action: SHIFT_ADHOC_OVERRIDE
- before_value: previous_sessions
- after_value: updated_sessions

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Attendance Engine Redis Listener:
1. Invalidate Existing Punch Pairings
2. Unlink Current Explanation Trace
3. Re-execute Chronological Pairing against New Instance
4. Re-calculate Daily Coverage Ratio (N66a)
5. Commit New Explanation Trace

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Rollup Record Updated
& Attendance Grid Refreshed
